notes.author: ted
notes.text: Josh has been coming with a coworker from Ocotillo Market for a while now. He asked me what baptism actually means, so we are meeting for coffee next week.

notes.author: ted
notes.text: Followed up with Josh after his baptism. He wants to keep growing, so I introduced him to Mike and Jen Rivera and their group.

notes.author: ted
notes.text: Ask Josh in person whether he would share his story at the next baptism Sunday. He is shy, so not in front of anyone else.
notes.testPurpose: A private reminder, seen only by its author.
